paper_metadata.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: In this report, we introduce Qwen2.5, a comprehensive series of large language models (LLMs) designed to meet diverse needs. Compared to previous iterations, Qwen 2.5 has been significantly improved during both the pre-training and post-training stages. In terms of pre-training, we have scaled the high-quality pre-training datasets from the previous 7 trillion tokens to 18 trillion tokens. This provides a strong foundation for common sense, expert knowledge, and reasoning capabilities. In terms of post-training, we implement intricate supervised finetuning with over 1 million samples, as well as multistage reinforcement learning. Post-training techniques enhance human preference, and notably improve long text generation, structural data analysis, and instruction following. To handle diverse and varied use cases effectively, we present Qwen2.5 LLM series in rich sizes. Open-weight offerings include base and instruction-tuned models, with quantized versions available. In addition, for hosted solutions, the proprietary models currently include two mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants: Qwen2.5-Turbo and Qwen2.5-Plus, both available from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Qwen2.5 has demonstrated top-tier performance on a wide range of benchmarks evaluating language understanding, reasoning, mathematics, coding, human preference alignment, etc. Specifically, the open-weight flagship Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct outperforms a number of open and proprietary models and demonstrates competitive performance to the state-of-the-art open-weight model, Llama-3-405B-Instruct, which is around 5 times larger. Qwen2.5-Turbo and Qwen2.5-Plus offer superior cost-effectiveness while performing competitively against GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o respectively. Additionally, as the foundation, Qwen2.5 models have been instrumental in training specialized models such as Qwen2.5-Math, Qwen2.5-Coder, QwQ, and multimodal models.

extraction_data.innovation: Better data mixture: strategic down-sampling of overrepresented domains (e-commerce, social media) and up-sampling of high-value domains (technology, science, academic research) to create a balanced, information-rich dataset; Scaling laws for hyper-parameters to optimize learning rate and batch size across architectures; Two-phase long-context pre-training with RoPE base frequency extension (ABF technique), YARN, and Dual Chunk Attention (DCA) to scale context from 4K to 32K/1M tokens; Two-stage reinforcement learning (Offline RL for reasoning/factuality, Online RL for nuance/safety) and expanded SFT data coverage for long-sequence generation and complex tasks.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 18 trillion tokens of high-quality pre-training datasets
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Offline Reinforcement Learning (DPO), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Supervised fine-tuning for long-sequence generation, math, coding, instruction-following, structured data understanding, logical reasoning, cross-lingual transfer
extraction_data.research_problem: Language modeling, long-sequence generation, mathematics, coding, instruction-following, structured data understanding, logical reasoning
extraction_data.application: Long-sequence generation, mathematical problem-solving, coding, instruction-following, structured data understanding, logical reasoning, cross-lingual transfer
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Over 1 million samples, long-response datasets, Qwen2.5-Math chain-of-thought data, Qwen2.5-Coder instruction tuning data, code-related Q&A websites, GitHub algorithmic code snippets, structured understanding dataset, 70, 000 logical reasoning queries, 1 million SFT examples, 150, 000 DPO training pairs, 1 million examples across SFT, DPO, and GRPO stages, Long-response datasets generated via back-translation from pre-training corpora; millions of high-quality examples for SFT
extraction_data.supported_language: English, Chinese, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Turkish, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and many others, and 27 other languages
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Sparse attention based on Minference, Grouped Query Attention (GQA), Dual Chunk Attention (DCA)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Back-translation for long-text data; rejection sampling with reward modeling/annotated answers for math; multiple language-specific agents for coding; LLM-generated instructions with verification code and unittests for cross-validation; translation model for cross-lingual transfer, Leverages Qwen2-72B-Instruct and Qwen2-Math-RM-72B to generate high-quality synthetic data in math, code, and knowledge domains, filtered by a proprietary general reward model, Back-translation techniques to generate queries for long-text data from pre-training corpora
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: DPO, GRPO, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Multi-stage RL, Offline RL, Online RL
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Execution feedback, answer matching, human and automated review processes, dedicated critic model, multi-agent collaborative scoring system, Reward model evaluating truthfulness, helpfulness, conciseness, relevance, harmlessness, and debiasing
